chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from al-Nawfali, from al-Sakuni, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
Drinking water while standing during the daytime is more strengthening and more healthful for the body.

key_terms.النَّهَارِ: daytime — the temporal qualifier distinguishing this ruling from night-time practices
key_terms.الْبَدَنِ: the body — physical health and constitution
key_terms.قِيَامٍ: standing upright — the specific physical posture referenced in the ruling

ai.seo_question: What did Imam al-Sadiq say about drinking water while standing during the day?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) states that drinking water while standing during the daytime is beneficial for physical health and strength. This hadith is part of a broader chapter in al-Kafi on the etiquette of drinking water, reflecting the Imams' concern for the physical well-being of their followers alongside spiritual guidance. The original audience would have understood this as practical medical wisdom transmitted through prophetic authority.
